name: insufficient_evidence
description: The worker produced only a single short delta before the periodic checkpoint. Haiku is invoked but cannot establish semantic health from the bounded window; the supervisor normalizes the result to uncertain and emits one advisory attention.
original_prompt: Investigate the intermittent test failure in the supervision evidence suite.

evidence: Only a single short delta was available; no tool activity or final progress to assess.

false_alert_note: This is a true uncertain verdict, not a false alert. The controller is woken once so it can decide whether to wait, inspect logs, or interrupt; the worker is not auto-acted on.
